line.a_kto_tam.text: Hey, who is hiding behind that bush?

line.a_zbudujemy.text: Don't worry, Hedgehog! We'll build you a house.

line.a_z_czego.text: But what will we build it from?

line.a_z_figur.text: From shapes! They are lying here in the grass. For the walls we need a square.

line.a_kolo.text: This is a circle. Run your finger along the path, from the green dot.

line.a_kolo_ok.text: A circle is round and has no corners at all.

line.a_trojkat.text: And this is a triangle. Draw it with your finger.

line.a_policz.text: Now touch every corner of the square.

line.a_trzy_rogi.text: A triangle has three corners. It's pointy like the roof of a house.

line.a_kwadrat.text: And this is a square. Draw it with your finger.

line.a_cztery_rogi.text: A square has all its sides the same. It looks like a little window.

line.a_budujemy.text: Now we know the shapes. Let's build Hedgehog's house!

line.b_plan.text: The shapes are lying on the grass. We'll mark with a pencil where each one goes.

line.b_sciany.text: Walls first. The walls are a square. Drag the square to its place.

line.b_dach.text: Three corners and three sides, it's a triangle! We have a roof.

line.b_okno.text: The window will be round. Which shape has no corners? Drag it onto the window.

line.b_drzwi.text: And the door is a rectangle, two long sides and two short ones. Drag the rectangle onto the door.

line.b_nie_ta.text: That shape doesn't fit here. Look at its corners and sides, and try another one.

line.b_nie_ta.lisek.text: That shape doesn't fit here. Look at its corners and sides, and try another one.

line.b_gotowy.text: The house is ready! Square walls, a triangle roof, a round window and a rectangle door.

line.b_dziekuje.text: My very own house! Thank you!

line.c_latawiec.text: There are kites here, but not mine. Mine was a square, and none of these is a square!

line.c_ktory.text: Remember? We know a shape by its corners and sides. Point to the kite that is a square.

line.c_ktory_nie.text: That's not a square. A square has all its sides the same length.

line.c_obrocony.text: The square is only turned, but all its sides are still the same. A turned square is still a square!

line.c_dziekuje.text: That's my kite! Thanks! Let's fly it again!

line.c_do_domu.text: Hooray! We'll bake biscuits for it. Let's go home!

line.p_start.text: Let's practise shapes! I have five games.

line.p_tangram.text: Build the house from the pieces. Drag them, and touch one to turn it.

line.p_trojkat.text: The shapes have turned around. Point to the triangle.

line.p_trojkat_nie.text: That's not a triangle. A triangle is pointy, like a roof.

line.p_prostokat.text: Draw a rectangle with your finger, from the green dot.

line.p_bez_rogow.text: Point to the shape that has no corners at all.

line.p_bez_rogow_nie.text: That shape has corners. Look for the round one.

line.d_rodzice.text: Play this guessing game at home with your parents: I can see something round, I can see something with three corners!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for my new house! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Hedgehog. We built him a house from shapes: a square, a triangle, a circle and a rectangle.

line.a_nie_mam_domu.text: It's me, Hedgehog... Winter is coming, and I have no house. I have nowhere to hide.

line.a_policz_trojkat.text: Let's count its corners. Touch every corner.

line.p_kolorowanka_znak.text: Colour the house. Pick a crayon with a sign, then a part with the same sign.

line.b_rysunek.text: Do you know what? I drew the little house I dream of. Look!

line.b_rysunek_trojkat.text: What a lovely drawing! We'll build the very same house. Point to the triangle in the drawing.

line.b_rysunek_nie.text: That's not a triangle. A triangle has three corners and is pointy.

line.b_rysunek_dach.text: Yes! The roof is a triangle. The walls are a square, the window is a circle and the door is a rectangle. Let's build that house from shapes!

line.a_nie_kwadrat.text: Here is the square! But that other one is not a square. It stands on its corner and it's pointy, so it's some other shape.

line.a_obroc.text: Are you sure? Watch, I'll turn it.

line.a_jak_poznac.text: Now it looks just the same! So how do you know which shape it is?

line.a_rogi_boki.text: We know a shape by its corners and sides, not by the way it stands.

line.a_co_to.text: By its corners and sides? What does that mean?

line.a_pokaze.text: I'll show you. We'll draw the shapes with a finger!

line.a_wszystkie_kwadraty.text: Point to all the squares lying in the grass.

line.a_kwadraty_nie.text: That's not a square. A square has all its sides the same.

line.a_oba_kwadraty.text: Both are squares! They have the same corners and equal sides. A turned square is still a square!

line.b_pokaz.text: Show me, show me! I want to see too!

line.b_podarlem.text: Oh no... I tore it. I'm sorry, Hedgehog!

line.b_posklejaj.text: Never mind. Put the drawing together from its pieces, and it will be as good as new.

line.b_maly_trojkat.text: And here is a triangle for the roof!

line.b_za_maly.text: That triangle is too small for a roof. Let's make a big one: a triangle is three corners joined by sides.

line.b_kropki.text: Join the dots with your finger, from the smallest to the biggest.

line.b_wiatr.text: Oh no, the wind took my kite! It flew off to the playground!

line.b_szukamy.text: Don't worry, Bunny. Let's go and find it!

line.c_herbatka.text: Come to tea in my new house tomorrow, all of you!

line.p_tangram_ok.text: The house from pieces is ready, just like Hedgehog's house!

line.p_trojkat_ok.text: Yes, that's the triangle! It has three corners, even when it's turned.

line.p_prostokat_ok.text: A lovely rectangle: two long sides and two short ones.

line.p_bez_rogow_ok.text: Yes, the circle! It's round and has no corners at all.

line.d_herbatka.text: Tomorrow it's tea in my house! I'm so happy!

line.d_ciasteczka.text: Let's bake biscuits in the shapes of your house: circles, squares, triangles and rectangles!

line.d_brakuje.text: We still need a rectangle for Owl. Cut it out of the dough: run your finger along the path.

line.d_wyciete.text: There's the rectangle biscuit! Two long sides and two short ones.

line.d_talerzyki.text: Now every shape on a plate of its own.

line.d_pomoge.text: I'll help! The triangle biscuit on this plate.

line.d_spiczaste.text: And this one here too, because it's pointy, like a triangle!

line.d_rogi.text: Wait, Bunny! Let's look at its corners. Touch every corner of the biscuit.

line.d_kwadrat.text: A triangle has three corners, and this biscuit has more. All its sides are the same: it's a square, only turned!

line.d_zapomnialem.text: A turned square is still a square! I forgot.

line.d_poloz.text: Put all the biscuits on the plates, one shape on each plate.

line.d_poloz_nie.text: There are different shapes on that plate. Look at the corners and sides.

line.d_gotowe.text: Circles, squares, triangles and rectangles, each on its own plate!

line.d_zgadywanka.text: While they cool, let's play a guessing game! I can see something in the kitchen that is round, like a circle.

line.d_zegar.text: I know! The clock on the wall!

line.d_trzy_rogi.text: My turn! Point to something in the kitchen that has three corners.

line.d_trzy_rogi_nie.text: That doesn't have three corners. Look for something pointy.

line.d_kanapka.text: Yes, the sandwich! It's a triangle, it has three corners.

line.d_herbatka_ok.text: My first tea in my new house! Everybody loves the shape biscuits.

line.b_caly.text: My drawing is whole again! Thank you.

line.b_okienko.text: A round window! I'll look out at the forest through it.

line.a_kwadraty_nie_cztery.text: That's not a square. A square has four corners and four equal sides.
